summary_en: 400,000 shares (1.96% of S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥1,605/share (2026-08-06 close) on 2026-08-07, maximum outlay ¥642.0M, execution at Tokyo Stock Exchange 08:45 JST on the single-trading-session order window; capital efficiency and shareholder return objective.
title_en: Notice of acquisition of treasury shares and block acquisition via over-the-counter transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-06, the board of MAEZAWA KYUSO INDUSTRIES (TSE Standard, code 6485) resolved to acquire up to 400,000 of its own shares via an over-the-counter block transaction (ToSTNeT-3). The purchase will be executed at the Tokyo Stock Exchange's 08:45 JST session on 2026-08-07 at a fixed price of ¥1,605 per share (the prior trading day's close), with a maximum total outlay of ¥642.0 million. This block represents 1.96% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury base of 20,357,929 shares as of 2026-07-31). The buy order will be valid only for that single trading session, with results to be announced immediately after market close. As of the filing date, the company held 1,142,071 treasury shares. The stated rationale is to improve capital efficiency and enhance shareholder returns.
